items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: I played a job with him with Ray McNamara... Louis was playing bass then... Who was the bass player you replaced? Louis Macenthal.

ctx.x: Yeah. I stayed down there. I played a job with him with Ray McNamara. And he told me, but Paul, Louis was playing bass then, you know. Yeah. And he told me, he says, say kid, he says, would you be interested in playing with me over there? And I said, yeah, I guess so. So he says, you'll hear from me. I said, well, how much did you get? Huh? $21? $21 a week? Yeah, $21 a week. $11. You had another day off, didn't you? Yeah. No, no, no, no. Day off.
An hour and a half a day. Who was the bass player you replaced? Louis Macenthal. Louis Macenthal. And you want to know the funny thing about that job? Because I started with...
You started with... You played with us a while.
